NewsArticle.Title: The Sacrifice: Daughter Kidnapped
NewsArticle.Content: Bard of Undine, Hesperos has become silent. His daughter Kalliope was taken from him under the shroud of night. Hesperos writes: Where is my child? She is my love, my blood. The day she would sing to me until serenity. Now, Kalliope is gone. She has been stolen away under the noses of Loures' soldiers. Under the noses of everyone. I awoke from another horrid dream too late. All I saw was the shape of a wolf carrying my daughter from me. Wolf's bane to all the dogs of the forest and beyond. Return to me my child! The pools of Undine offer me no peace until my Kalliope is here again. I have heard of many a wicked ritual performed in the woodlands at the new year. On behalf of Undine, on behalf of my beloved little one, I ask your help in rescuing her this new year before any wicked rite should befall her innocent form. Distraught Hesperos The Sacrifice: 99.10.01 - 99.10.03 The 7th Year of Deoch begins 99.10.01. Undine's movement begins 99.10.01 5 p.m. Ends 99.10.03 7 p.m. Enter Dark Ages, listen to the Events of Temuair and talk to Hesperos in Undine Tavern for details. Read "Wood Goblin Social Structure" in Loures Library Philosophy wing: [www.darkages.com/atavism/phi](http://www.darkages.com/atavism/phi)
